name: Olas Trader
description: Autonomous on-chain agent that places bets on prediction markets such as Omen and Polymarket using AI-estimated probabilities.
whatItDoes: Continuously finds open prediction markets, requests a probability estimate, and bets when it sees an edge. It is run by people participating in the Olas agent economy.
howItWorks: Built as an Open Autonomy service, it runs as a finite-state machine that samples markets, asks an AI Mech service for a prediction, and transacts through a Safe wallet. Most users run it through the Pearl app; developers set it up from source.

requirements.name: Agent key and Safe
requirements.description: Funded on-chain accounts on Gnosis or Polygon

models: Predictions supplied by AI Mech tools
